synonyms: The Invader Comes From the Bottom of the Sea!
description:
Foolish land-born air breathers! Behold the terror from the depths, the tentacled conqueror of humanity: Squid Girl! With your pollution and stuff you really deserve it, so prepare for menacing, inky doom!

Squid Girl has come from the depths of the sea to conquer humanity for its pollution of the ocean. Within moments of arriving on the surface world, our easily distracted, little invertebrate is promptly bullied into working for the Aizawa sisters as a waitress, supplying their restaurant with squid ink. If poor Squid Girl can't handle two pushy Japanese girls, how will she ever subjugate the human race?

(Source: Media Blasters)

node.description:
A squid girl who claims to be "A Messenger of the Sea". 

Frustrated about her ocean being polluted by human beings, she planned to conquer the world to exact revenge on humanity. However, she soon realizes that she doesn't stand a chance against anyone, as she is clueless about the surface and is alone in her conquest. As a result of breaking a side of a beach house's wall during her invasion, she is forced to work there and learns more about humans and their ways. She is known to be very stubborn, insists that eventually she'll be able to conquer humanity, has a fear of sharks and whales, loves shrimp, can spew out ink at will, and can use her blue hair as tentacles.

Chizuru is the proud owner and manager of the Lemon Beach House. She is [Eiko Aizawa](https://anilist.co/character/34653/Eiko-Aizawa) and [Takeru Aizawa's](https://anilist.co/character/37242/Takeru-Aizawa) eldest sister. 

Unlike her sister, Chizuru is much calmer and cares more for [Ika](https://anilist.co/character/20512/Ika-Musume). She tends to be more quiet and reserved, and she's almost always shown with shut eyes and a smile no matter the situation. However, if something occurs which she does not agree with, she has a darker violent side of herself: Being shown to have a terrifying, menacing aura coupled with a very dark mindset towards anyone unfortunate enough to make her mad. Whenever she is angry, she 'opens' her eyes, usually to freak out or intimidate the person (or squid) she is angry at.

A girl who works at the Lemon Beach House alongside her older sister.

After [Ika](https://anilist.co/character/20512/Ika-Musume) fails to invade the surface, she forces them to work for her to pay off a part of the wall she destroyed. She is the younger sister to [Chizuru Aizawa](https://anilist.co/character/34654/Chizuru-Aizawa) and older sister to [Takeru Aizawa](https://anilist.co/character/37242/Takeru-Aizawa). She is typically the one who is the most annoyed by Squid Girl's antics, getting easily frustrated with them and not showing much concern for her well-being or safety.

Sanae is [Eiko Aizawa's](https://anilist.co/character/34653/Eiko-Aizawa) childhood friend and classmate, and is completely infatuated with [Ika Musume](https://anilist.co/character/20512/Ika-Musume).

Sanae has an obsessive crush over Ika Musume, much to their dismay. She is constantly taking pictures of Ika, and often imagines situations in which she would win over Ika's heart, and gets jealous whenever she sees other girls with Ika. Ika does not return Sanae's affections, and is often disgusted by Sanae's attempts to approach her, to the point where she often hit them away with their tentacles and spray them with ink. This doesn't help however, as Sanae seems to exhibit a strange masochistic pleasure out of this. Although, if she's called up by Eiko for a serious errand, Sanae is able to keep calm even when around Ika and help out. She owns a pet dog named [Alex](https://anilist.co/character/53811/Alex), and keeps a wardrobe full of cosplay outfits.
The daughter of the owner of a rival beach house.

A gentle girl with a peaceful aura, who sometimes talks with Ika, hinting that invading might not be the best thing to do as not all humans are bad. It is implied that she also comes from the sea, as she has a hat similar to Ika's and makes statements that indicate she isn't human. The first syllables of her name spell out 'tako' (たこ), meaning octopus.

[Eiko](https://anilist.co/character/34653/Eiko-Aizawa) and [Chizuru](https://anilist.co/character/34654/Chizuru-Aizawa)'s little brother, who enjoys playing with [Ika](https://anilist.co/character/20512/Ika-Musume).

Compared to his sisters, Takeru acts very childish and carefree, and actually goes out of his way to befriend Ika. She appears to regard him mostly with disinterest and appears to have a low opinion of him, though she frequently plays with him anyway. He goes to elementary school and is taught under his teacher, [Aiko Saitou](https://anilist.co/character/51377/Aiko-Saitou). He is friends with a variety of other kids, including [Yuuta Matsumoto](https://anilist.co/character/40730/Yuuta-Matsumoto), [Shouta Kuroishi](https://anilist.co/character/51383/Shouta-Kuroishi), and [Satoshi](https://anilist.co/character/51379/Satoshi), among others.

name.native: シンディー・キャンベル

node.description: An extraterrestrial researcher from the United States who believes Ika to be an alien and wishes to take her back with her for research.
A middle schoolgirl who Ika makes friends with after a prank gone wrong. She is the first person who Ika makes friends with and they soon become best friends. She is also on a baseball team.

Goro Arashiyama is a lifeguard at the local beach, and an old friend of the Aizawa siblings.

As a self-proclaimed "Protector of the Sea", he has a mutual respect for [Ika](https://anilist.co/character/20512), despite seeing her as a hassle. He has a strong crush on [Chizuru](https://anilist.co/character/34654) that she seems to not be aware of. He even keeps a picture of her as his phone's background image. Because of this crush, he seemingly can't refuse any request made by Chizuru.
Sanae's pet dog.  Dislikes Squid Girl since Sanae loves her more.

A surf-loving girl who starts working at the Lemon Beach House. She has an older sister, [Aiko Saitou](https://anilist.co/character/51377/Aiko-Saitou).

Unlike everyone else, she sees [Ika](https://anilist.co/character/20512/Ika-Musume) as an actual threat to humanity, and is genuinely afraid of her. She often tries to warn the others and get them on the same page, though, nobody else feels the same way. Ika enjoys the fact that Nagisa fears her and constantly teases her whenever she can. Nagisa is also a high-schooler, but does not attend the same high school as that of [Eiko Aizawa](https://anilist.co/character/34653/Eiko-Aizawa) and [Sanae Nagatsuki](https://anilist.co/character/34656/Sanae-Nagatsuki). In addition to being a keen surfer, Nagisa also rides a bike and can jump rope. Nagisa also likes watching magical girl and tokusatsu shows on TV in her spare time.
A friend of Takeru's that appears various times throughout the series.

The owner of a rival beach house and the father of Ayumu Tokita. He's a strong, competitive man who often tries to take advantage of Ika Musume's popularity to gain support for his own beach house. He's also seen having a high level of mechanical experience and enjoys boasting about his inventions.   ~! Despite his angry and blunt nature, he cares very much for his daughter and is grateful to Ika Musume and her friends for helping Ayumu to overcome her shyness. !~
